Messages.Author: Megabaja
Messages.Body:
I'm trying to remember where I read that a minion can prevent damage with card only from one source if it's not stated otherwise on the card... or am I wrong?

Can Resilience prevent both hand strike damage and enviromental damage with single copy of the card?

Ignorance is bliss.
Cypher, Matrix

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
> Megabaja wrote:
> I'm trying to remember where I read that a minion can prevent damage with card only from one source if it's not stated otherwise on the card... or am I wrong?
>
This is a false memory.
There are cards that only prevent damage from the opposing minions strike, card text will be explicit and clear when this is the case.

> Megabaja wrote:
> Can Resilience prevent both hand strike damage and environmental damage with single copy of the card?
>
Yes.
Soak  can prevent two from Scorpion Sting and two from Carrion Crows so long as they are resolving at the same damage resolution phase.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
You might've confused it with this:
Almost all prevention cards only prevent damage as they are played. There are only few (well, it's past-midnight, and can only think of one) that would save some prevention for later in the round: Apparition.

You can split Apparition's "may prevent 2 damage this round" into two "may prevent 1 damage this round", which can happen, one in the before range is set step, and the other in the press step of the same round.

Ah. Yeah. Coagulated Entity does the same thing.
